description: This file defines a React component named SettingsPage that provides UI and functionality for exporting/importing JSON data, backing up local state, restoring backups, and resetting demo data within a React-based application.

methods.name: pushToast
methods.description: A placeholder function for triggering toast notifications (currently a no-op).

methods.name: showStatus
methods.description: Sets a status message to inform the user about success, error, or info events, and clears it after 2.6 seconds.

methods.name: onExport
methods.description: Handles export button click: builds filename and payload, triggers JSON download, creates a local backup, and shows success status.

methods.name: handleImportPayload
methods.description: Processes imported payload: validates, normalizes, applies to state, handles modes (merge or replace), and updates status.

methods.name: onImportFileChange
methods.description: Handles file input change event: validates, reads JSON file, invokes import handler, manages busy state and errors.

methods.name: onRestoreLastBackup
methods.description: Restores the last backup entry: validates, applies to state, backs up current state pre-restore, and updates status.
